packs.description: Semantic relations for commands, events, routes, handlers, schemas, policies, and endpoints.

relations.description: The target handler executes the source command, event, or route.
The source accepts input conforming to the target schema.
The source is gated by the target authorization policy.
Executing the source may emit the target event.
The source semantic operation is exposed through the target transport endpoint.
The source workflow state permits a transition to the target state.

packs.description: Minimal structural relations shared by language and domain adapters.

relations.description: The source structurally contains the target.
The target is a physical realization of the source concept or contract.
The source is constrained by the target schema or specification.
The source is derived from the target.
The source deterministically or procedurally produces the target.
The source requires the target.
The source and target intentionally duplicate the same scoped facts.
The source documentation describes the target.
The source provides evidence about the target.
The source makes the target externally addressable.
The source identifies or points to the target without implying ownership.
The target defines the intended behavior or constraints of the source.
